persons.name: Jayajitāmitramalla
persons.evidence: śrī śrī sumatijayajitāmitra malladeva sanaśca(!) pustaka dayakā(!)

relations.evidence: śrī śrī sumatijayajitāmitra malladeva sanaśca(!) pustaka dayakā(!) || bhāgīrāma paramānayāvelasa

notes: Newari 'sanaśca' reflects the honorific ergative agentive suffix -sana/-sena (i.e. 'by King Sumati Jayajitāmitramalladeva the book was caused to be made'). 'paramāna' represents the Newar title pramāṇa (administrative officer/minister).
